name: Scratched Iron
author: Amal Kumar
processing: Positive roughness detail and recessed displacement isolated with wrapped Gaussian blurs (9 px and 7 px). Percentile levels .03/.995. Wrapped 15 px directional averaging isolates long scratches, with 11% of the original detail blended back in. Final contrast stretched at .04/.994. Matched the repeating joins by feathering opposite borders across four pixels. Lossless grayscale WebP.

name: Pitted Steel
author: Amal Kumar
processing: Local deviation in scan displacement using a wrapped 12 px blur, combined with roughness. Percentile levels .04/.994, wrapped 0.6 px smoothing. Midtones raised with a 0.73 power curve. Preserves the original repeating tile. Lossless grayscale WebP.

name: Chipped Steel
author: Amal Kumar
processing: Red minus blue separates exposed oxidized steel from the cool paint in the calibrated diffuse photo. Percentile levels .11/.94, wrapped 0.55 px smoothing. Preserves the original repeating tile. Lossless grayscale WebP.
